title: Libby clinical-evidence row
description: Row per published clinical-evidence finding. Appended by clinician agent. Per-manuscript decision-relevant fields modeled on the io-shieldbreak pharmacodynamic-results table layout.

inclusion_status.description: Did this paper enter the synthesis fed to the tumor board (`included`), or was it reviewed and excluded (`considered_excluded`)? The master manuscripts page renders both; the per-intervention evidence page and the board read `included` only.

exclusion_reason.description: Required when `inclusion_status: considered_excluded`. Brief reason — e.g. 'drug discontinued (Rova-T withdrawal)', 'wrong line of therapy', 'biomarker mismatch (BRCA-mut required)', 'preprint without peer review', 'superseded by larger trial in same population'.

intervention_id.description: Stable kebab-case ID grouping rows that share an intervention; PI uses to aggregate across rows.

intervention_dose.description: Dose / schedule as published (e.g. 'cabozantinib 60 mg PO daily', '10 mg IV q2w with 1 mg step-up'). Null if not reported.

population_detail.description: Subset / biomarker / prior-therapy details that scope the cohort. e.g. 'EGFR-mut + MET amp post-osimertinib', 'ECOG 0-1 only'.

design.description: RCT, single-arm phase 2, basket, retrospective cohort, etc.

comparator.description: — for single-arm; named comparator for RCTs.

outcome.description: Free-text outcome name; e.g. 'ORR (BICR)', 'median PFS', 'OS HR vs comparator'.

endpoint_type.description: Endpoint family for sortability and grouping in the rendered table.

variance_or_ci.description: Free-text variance description when numeric CI bounds are not separable (e.g. 'IQR 1.5-4.2').

median_dor_or_pfs.description: Durability — median DoR / PFS / time-on-treatment as reported. e.g. 'mDoR 7.0 mo', 'mPFS 3.6 mo'.

outcomes.description: Structured list of every reported outcome on this paper — response-rate, OS, PFS, RFS, DFS, DCR, etc. — captured one per array entry. Renders directly into the Effect size + Variance columns of the master manuscripts table, one stacked line per outcome. Lets a single paper carry multiple endpoints cleanly (e.g. DeLLphi-304 reports OS HR, PFS, ORR, mDoR — four entries) instead of collapsing into one number plus free-text overflow. When `outcomes[]` is populated, the renderer prefers it; the legacy single-outcome fields (`endpoint_type`, `effect_size`, `effect_units`, `ci_lower`, `ci_upper`, `variance_or_ci`, `p_value`, `median_dor_or_pfs`) remain for backwards compatibility and as a fallback when `outcomes[]` is absent.

name.description: Outcome family. ORR = overall response rate (CR+PR). RR = response rate (synonym; for cases where the paper just says 'response rate'). DCR = disease-control rate (CR+PR+SD). DoR = median duration of response. PFS / OS / RFS / DFS / EFS = median time in months. *_rate variants = % of patients meeting a landmark threshold (e.g. 1y OS rate). HR_* = hazard ratio vs comparator. TTR = time to response. TTP = time to progression. TTNT = time to next therapy.

effect_size.description: Numeric or short string. ORR / DCR / *_rate use % (e.g. 40); median time variants use months (e.g. 4.9); HR_* use the ratio (e.g. 0.60).

effect_units.description: Free-text units. %, months, HR, etc. Optional when implied by the `name` (HR_OS implies ratio; ORR implies %).

variance_or_ci.description: Free-text variance when numeric CI bounds aren't separable (e.g. 'IQR 1.5-4.2', '95% CI by Kaplan-Meier').

p_value.description: p-value (numeric or '<0.001'). Mostly meaningful for HR_* / comparator-based outcomes.

n.description: Patients evaluable for THIS outcome (may differ from the row-level `n` for biomarker-restricted analyses, ITT vs PP cuts, etc.). Null when same as row `n`.

subgroup.description: Optional subgroup label when the outcome is from a stratified analysis — e.g. 'KRAS G12 subset', 'BRCA2 carriers', 'PD-L1 ≥50%'. Leave empty for the full-population estimand.

notes.description: Short qualifier — '10 mg cohort', 'BICR-confirmed', 'investigator-assessed', 'landmark at 12 months', 'interim cut'.

safety_summary.description: 1-2 line summary: G3+ AE rate, treatment-related deaths, characteristic AEs (CRS, ILD, neuropathy, etc).

toxicities.description: Structured per-AE rows for the master manuscripts table. Capture decision-relevant toxicities: high-grade events, characteristic class effects, treatment-discontinuation drivers, AEs flagged in `preferences.toxicity_vetoes`. Multiple grade rows for the same term are allowed (e.g. one row for 'any grade', one for '>=3').

term.description: AE term, CTCAE-aligned where possible. e.g. 'CRS', 'ILD/pneumonitis', 'hand-foot reaction', 'hypertension'.

grade.description: Grade scope: 'any' | '1-2' | '>=3' | '3' | '4' | '5'. Use '>=3' for the union grade-3-5 rate.

n_events.description: Number of patients with the event. Null when only a percentage is reported.

denominator.description: Cohort size for this rate. If omitted, the row-level `n` is assumed.

rate_pct.description: Frequency as percent. Capture exactly as reported.

risk_of_bias.description: Per-paper RoB call. Use RoB2 for RCTs, ROBINS-I for non-randomized, informal for narrative-style review.

case_match.description: How well does this paper's population match the patient profile? `strong` = same indication + line + biomarker. `partial` = same indication, different line/biomarker subset. `weak` = same drug class only. `cross_tumor_only` = different tumor type, included for mechanism/efficacy precedent.

pmid.description: PubMed ID as a bare numeric string (no 'PMID:' prefix); null when the source has no PubMed record. Existence/correctness is verified by the reference_checking skill, not this format gate.

doi.description: DOI in bare 10.xxxx/... form (no https:// or doi.org prefix); null when none.
